mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pot_listing_bookmark(id, pot_listing_id, user_uid, created_at) VALUES(pot_listing_bookmark_seq.nextval, #{id}, #{userUid}, sysdate)
mapper.delete: DELETE pot_listing_bookmark WHERE pot_listing_id=#{id} AND user_uid=#{userUid}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT pl.*, ui.nickname AS writer_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chatroom WHERE pot_listing_id = pl.id) AS chatroom_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pot_listing_bookmark WHERE pot_listing_id = pl.id) AS bookmark_count FROM pot_listing_bookmark pb JOIN pot_listing pl ON pl.id = pb.pot_listing_id JOIN user_info ui ON ui.uuid = pl.writer_uid LEFT JOIN pot_listing_tag_mapping ptm ON ptm.pot_listing_id = pl.id LEFT JOIN plant_tag pt ON pt.tag_id = ptm.plant_tag_id WHERE pb.user_uid = #{userUid} ORDER BY pl.id DESC
